triggering_failure: WGSRPD Level-3 WCVP area codes such as ALA and AFG did not match the numeric Level3_cod field assumed by the first audit implementation.
diagnosis: WCVP area_code_l3 uses the official three-letter WGSRPD Level-3 code. The pinned WGSRPD distribution includes authoritative hierarchy tables in which tblLevel3 maps that three-letter code to Level-2, tblLevel2 maps Level-2 to Level-1, and tblLevel1 supplies the Level-1 botanical-continent name.

correction.old_crosswalk: Attempt to map WCVP three-letter area_code_l3 directly through the Level-3 GeoJSON properties.
correction.new_crosswalk: Use pinned official tblLevel3.txt -> tblLevel2.txt -> tblLevel1.txt at the same WGSRPD commit.
